main_text.l: plena probatio habeatur testimonium affirmativum testis jurati, modo is non fit in minifterio ipsius Oldermanni, qui rejiciut sufpectus potest. Oldermannus & judices hi nihil potestatis, aut jurisdictionis sibi sufurpent in agrarios præter id, quod ad ipsorum cognitionem proprie pertinet: Idem Oldermannus ad hoc tribunal suum ne-minem citet ex agro nisi per mandatum Cameræ provincialis, id est, præsidis & Hoetmannorum: agrarij & peregrini à sententia hujus tribunalis Hovetmannos cum præside, cives senatum urbanum appellet, & recognitionem petant: Huic sententiæ in confessu ordinum generalium pronunciatæ, & nomine eorundem à summo scriba à secretis scripta, addidere judices idem aliam quod, eode die & loco. In eâ concedunt agrarijs ad exsolvendum æs alienum tributum agro toti imponere secundum jugera per octen-nium eo modo, quem ipsi sufficere arbitrantur, atque infuper ex bonis monasticis ex decreto ordinum generalium aureorum xvi millia capere: Vtramenæs hoc alienum prius liquidem fiat apud ipsos provinciæ ordines, nec excedat summam lxiiii millium aureorum, quam summam ipsi agrarij ante erant professi: utq; quotanis de hoc tributo apud generosum gubernatorem, & deleēctos ordinum provincialium rationes reddatur; ut agrariis ipsdem liceat vectigal.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right: "Sententia tertia eorum" (sentence third of them) and "dem." Partial mark at the lower left "K 3" is a signature-like mark, treated as furniture and not transcribed as text. Some words are in italic in the original; the main text is long-s rendered as s. Several words are doubtful due to scan quality, notably "Hovetmannos" and "generosum"; the transcription above has not been verified letter by letter, so treat it as a draft. Bottom line "vectigal" is printed at the foot, not as a catchword.
